posts.author: Arcanum-edge
posts.body:
I used to post on HB Games many, many years ago (as far back as RMXP.org, even), and I haven't been active on any forums since really. But I decided to get back into RPG Maker recently, and upon finding out you can run XP on Crossover on Mac, I found out I could keep making a game that I hadn't touched in a lot of years. So hi! I'm a musician and pixel artist mostly, but I dabble in scripting sometimes. I still am pretty limited to just editing scripting stuff though.
Shameless plugs allowed? Or should I save it for its own thread? I made a video game music album a long time ago and am close to releasing another one. Links are possible.
Best,
Arc

posts.author: Framebitz
posts.body: Welcome back to RPG Maker Arc! It’s rare to see a musician/pixel artist combo.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body: Welcome to the forum and good luck on your projects!
